state:
**Goal `core-class-cards`: Stages 2 and 3 are done, and Stage 4 is under way.** The `codes!` macro in
`crates/nvs-diagnostics/src/lib.rs` reads an optional `.card("…")` after each `Code::new(…)` and
writes `code::card(code) -> Option<&'static str>` beside `code::ALL`. The lexer band `E0001`–`E0010`,
the parser band `E0101`–`E0135` and the rejected-PHP band `E0201`–`E0254` carry cards; every other
code is in the test module's `CODES_STILL_OWING_A_CARD`, in declaration order, and
`every_code_carries_its_card_or_is_listed` holds the two together both ways. `nvs agent show E0201`
prints a code's card.

`Renderer::render_all` closes every run that rendered a coded diagnostic with `AGENT_SHOW_LINE`. Codes
declared and never raised still carry cards, because the test counts declarations: four in the parser
band (`E0103`, `E0104`, `E0106`, `E0107`) and two in the rejected-PHP band (`E0206`, `E0207`). Stage 5
is not started.

next.title: every diagnostic code carries its card

items.text: **Drain the list, one band per session, in file order** — `rule:tooling/a-diagnostic-code-carries-its-card`; the name-resolution band starts at `crates/nvs-diagnostics/src/lib.rs:973` (`E0301`, through `E0327`). A card is one to three sentences for the person who met the error, in the voice of AGENTS.md § *Text an end user reads*. Read the `///` above the code and the site that raises it: one delegated `Explore` search returning `file.rs:NN  CONSTANT  message  help` per code keeps that reading out of the session, and it also reports a code nothing raises. Write every card of the band as one `bun nv splice --patch` (OLD `Code::new("E0301");`, NEW the `.card(…)` form), plus one block deleting the band from `CODES_STILL_OWING_A_CARD` at `crates/nvs-diagnostics/src/lib.rs:4376`, then `rustfmt --edition 2024` the file to reflow the list. The first sentence becomes the index line, so it must read alone. A band this short leaves room for the start of the `E04xx` types band in the same session.

**`no_code_still_owes_a_card`** — `rule:tooling/a-diagnostic-code-carries-its-card`; add it beside `every_code_carries_its_card_or_is_listed` at `crates/nvs-diagnostics/src/lib.rs:4423`, asserting `CODES_STILL_OWING_A_CARD` is empty. It lands with the commit that empties the list, never before: until then it is a red test.

backlog: Stage 5, help is owed for the whole roster: `docs/agent/goals/core-class-cards.md` § Stage 5.

The four parser codes nothing raises (`E0103`, `E0104`, `E0106`, `E0107`) and the two rejected-PHP codes nothing raises (`E0206`, `E0207`) are candidates for retirement; that is a decision for `crates/nvs-diagnostics/src/lib.rs`'s code table, not this goal.
